description: Defines a data transfer object class for filtering search parameters related to I18N groups in the OrangeHRM Admin plugin. It extends a base FilterParams class and specifies allowed sorting fields.

classes.name: OrangeHRM\Admin\Dto\I18NGroupSearchFilterParams
